name: Towel Chest Stretch
focus: Chest and front of the shoulders
description: Standing tall with a towel held behind you in both hands, arms straight, lift the towel back and away from you to open the chest.

source.title: Ripple: Towel chest stretch
source.note: Described in our own words. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Hold a towel behind you, hands wide apart, arms straight.

prescription.note: Stand tall; lift only as far as feels good.

keyframes.name: Towel behind you
keyframes.cue: Hold a towel behind you, hands wide, arms straight.

keyframes.name: Lift and open
keyframes.cue: Lift the towel away from you and squeeze your shoulder blades.
